title: A Knight In The Making - Episode 1
overview: Follow A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms from the page to the screen in this fascinating and comprehensive look at how HBO's newest series in the Game of Thrones universe was brought to life.

title: A Knight In The Making - Episodes 2 & 3
overview: Get the full scoop on Episodes 2 and 3 of A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms in this behind-the-scenes special that explores character arcs, the eye-popping jousting sequences, and the stunning Ep. 3 climax.

title: The Hedge Knight
overview: On his journey to the forthcoming tournament in Ashford, Dunk meets a clever young boy named Egg, who offers to be his squire.

title: Hard Salt Beef
overview: Dunk appeals to various lords in order to gain entrance into the tournament, but Egg advises him to hold onto his pride. When the Targaryens arrive at Ashford, Dunk seizes his moment with Prince Baelor.

title: The Squire
overview: The truth about Egg's identity is revealed as Dunk invites danger by doing the right thing and preparing for the tournament.
